about: One entry per target engine. `status` is set by run.py: `working` only after the real model produced Russian audio files in this environment. Blocked engines have NO adapter — only the recorded blocker. Every claim here cites where it was verified.

engines.label: RHVoice
engines.commercial_review: yes — 9 of the 14 Russian voices are CC-BY-NC-ND-4.0 (non-commercial); aleksandr-hq is CC-BY-SA-4.0; the rest LGPL-2.1+ per the Debian copyright file.

engines.label: Piper

voices.ru-irinia-medium: GPLv2 per the voice's MODEL_CARD (dataset: RHVoice); fine-tuned from the en_US lessac medium voice

engines.commercial_review: yes — voice is GPLv2 per its model card and is a fine-tune of the lessac voice, whose dataset terms need separate review.
engines.partial_blocker: The other Russian Piper voices (ru_RU-denis/dmitri/ruslan/irina-medium) are hosted only on huggingface.co/rhasspy/piper-voices — CONNECT 403 here. Only ru-irinia-medium is available as a GitHub release asset.

engines.label: XTTS v2
engines.python_package: coqui-tts 0.27.5 on PyPI (maintained idiap fork); requires PyTorch
engines.commercial_review: yes — CPML (Coqui Public Model License) model weights.

blocker.detail: Model weights are only served from huggingface.co (coqui/XTTS-v2). `curl https://huggingface.co/coqui/XTTS-v2/resolve/main/config.json` → `CONNECT tunnel failed, response 403` (environment network policy). download.pytorch.org is also refused (403).
blocker.unblock: Allow huggingface.co (and its LFS CDN) in the environment's network access settings, or run on a machine with that access.

engines.label: Qwen3-TTS
engines.model: Qwen/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-0.6B-CustomVoice / -1.7B-CustomVoice / -1.7B-Base (Russian listed in the official README)

license.model: not verifiable here — the model card is on huggingface.co / modelscope.cn

blocker.detail: Weights are served from huggingface.co and modelscope.cn. `curl https://huggingface.co/api/models/Qwen/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-Base` and `curl https://www.modelscope.cn/api/v1/models/Qwen/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-Base` → both `CONNECT tunnel failed, response 403`.

engines.label: Chatterbox Multilingual V3
engines.model: ResembleAI/chatterbox — t3_mtl23ls_v3.safetensors (+ ve.pt, s3gen.pt, conds.pt); Russian (ru) is in the language list
engines.python_package: chatterbox-tts 0.1.7 on PyPI (not verified to contain the V3 loader; GitHub master does); requires PyTorch

license.model: not verifiable here — model card is on huggingface.co

blocker.detail: mtl_tts.py downloads with huggingface_hub.snapshot_download(REPO_ID="ResembleAI/chatterbox"). `curl https://huggingface.co/api/models/ResembleAI/chatterbox` → `CONNECT tunnel failed, response 403`.

engines.label: CosyVoice 3
engines.model: FunAudioLLM/Fun-CosyVoice3-0.5B-2512 (Russian is one of its 9 languages per the official README)
engines.python_package: none official — the README installs from the GitHub repo; a `cosyvoice` 0.0.8 package exists on PyPI but is not verified as official

license.model: not verifiable here — model card is on modelscope.cn / huggingface.co

blocker.detail: The README downloads with modelscope.snapshot_download (or Hugging Face). `curl https://www.modelscope.cn/api/v1/models/FunAudioLLM/Fun-CosyVoice3-0.5B-2512` and `curl https://huggingface.co/api/models/FunAudioLLM/Fun-CosyVoice3-0.5B-2512` → both `CONNECT tunnel failed, response 403`.
